question: T12 (task-21179f1e2a10f308), after #760 (CAP-T12WAVEPHONE): in the phone view, do other Design presses move a Scrolling block's phone rows after a Wave Intensity fall that left the line running over, and what does a block below the Scrolling block in the same section do when its rows change? On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, one new section per plan, made on the desktop; then Mobile View (the frame 428 wide), and per block: select, Edit, Design, the plan's steps, a read after each and again after Escape (let go). p: 180>150, Animation speed 2x. q: 180>150, Fade edges. r: 180>150, Medium text size. s: 180>150, Item Spacing pressed on its range at 0.9 (0.5em to 2.7em). u: a Text block added to the section after the Scrolling block (phone 3/2/5/10, under it), then 180>90 on the Scrolling block. v: the same with a second Scrolling block. R1 read p to v, R2 v to p: every plan in two sessions. Nothing saved, each session left by Exit Without Saving.
readsAre: layout: the Scrolling block's desktop and phone grid areas, rows (the section's row count in the view shown), rowSizes, block (height), marquee and svg ([top in the block, height]), ctl (each Direction, Speed, Pause on hover, Fade edges and Text Size control's label and on state), value (the first range), ranges (each range: its label and value), all (each block in the section: me (the Scrolling block pressed), kind, desktop and phone areas, top in the section and height). The read's name is the session, the plan, and the steps in order, '>' between them.
answer: After 180>150 in the phone view (1/2/6/10, 5 rows, a 180 line running over), Animation speed 2x, Fade edges and Item Spacing keep the phone rows: 1/2/6/10, block 180.
Medium text size there refits the phone rows to the new line: 1/2/8/10, 7 rows, block 234, the line 218 high, 8 from its top.

A block under the Scrolling block in the phone view (phone 3/2/5/10, a Text block or a second Scrolling block alike) follows its foot: 180 takes the Scrolling block to 1/2/8/10 and the block below to 8/2/10/10 (top 245); 90 then takes them to 1/2/5/10 and 5/2/7/10 (top 140). The section has the rows of both (9, then 6). The block below keeps its height (59) and its desktop area.
R1 and R2 read alike in all 34 reads. The desktop areas stay as made throughout.
Not read: Text Style, Direction and Pause on hover in the phone view; a block above, beside or two rows below the Scrolling block; a block below on the desktop; more than two blocks.
